item.tib: dbang drag 'bar ba me phreng gi rgyud las bsad pa las kyi brnag pa
item.coloph: kho bo bde chen gling ces ming zol pa des gsang brag rdo rje nas gsang ba dngos grub tu brnyed (rnyed) ste phyis smar rdza mi g.yo bsam gling du shog ser bod yig tu sgyar bas bstan 'gro yang la 'phel rgyas bde legs shog/
